settings.question: How much energy does the 314Ah battery store?
settings.answer: The rated energy is 4,019.2Wh from the documented 12.8V and 314Ah ratings. Actual usable energy depends on operating limits, load and system settings.

settings.question: What is the difference between 157A and 200A?
settings.answer: 157A is the maximum continuous charge/discharge value used for normal system sizing. 200A is the BMS protection threshold, not a continuous operating rating. Use 63A as the recommended charge-current reference and size every system component to its lowest limit.

settings.question: Can the 314Ah battery use the same compartment as the 230Ah model?
settings.answer: The stated 522 × 268 × 222 mm enclosure dimensions are the same, but the 314Ah battery weighs 26kg. Recheck structure, restraint, access and the complete electrical design for the exact model.

settings.question: Should I choose the 314Ah or 230Ah battery?
settings.answer: Choose 314Ah when 2,010W covers your simultaneous load and you want 1,075.2Wh / 36.5% more reserve in the same 522 × 268 × 222mm enclosure. Choose 230Ah when 2,944Wh covers your time between charges and you want 2,560W continuous output, 5.4kg less weight and the lower current single-unit price. Test your devices in the Power Planner.

settings.question: Where can I review the complete operating limits?
settings.answer: The current English product manual is available in Documents on this page. Review it together with the charger, inverter and RV manufacturer instructions before installation.

settings.question: What conditions apply to the 8,000-cycle reference?
settings.answer: The 314Ah cycle-life reference is at least 8,000 cycles at 70% state of health (SOH), from the approved test condition of 0.5C charge and discharge to the 70% SOH end-of-test point. Actual cycle life varies with depth of discharge, charge and discharge rate, temperature and operating conditions.
